category_title: Probationary high school students with severe behavioral challenges and academic resistance
minimal_context: The tutor introduces the western industrial age to a world history class and asks the student to integrate drawing into the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are starting our unit on the western industrial age. For this assignment, I want you to integrate drawing into your notes about the inventions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Give me a reason why we have to draw. I'm not doing this work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is just the activity for today's class. Please get your pencils out and get started.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why are you teaching us bad kids? You're probably just making us do this so you can use us for your own personal gain.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am just trying to teach the lesson. Please look at the board and begin drawing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I refuse to do this work. I'm not cooperating with you and I'm paying no attention to this instruction.
